name: Lplermagrone
instructions: A variant on the theme: in the swiss canton of nidwalden , aelplermagrone is prepared with equal amounts of macaroni and potatoes
Dried apple slices are traditionally served as a side dish
Bring the milk and one tablespoon of salt to a boil
Add the noodles , reduce the heat , and cook over a low heat until done , stirring occasionally
The noodles should absorb enough milk so that the dish is still moist
While the pasta is cooking gently saute the onions in butter , and garlic cloves , keeps it low and slow so as not to burn the onion or garlic , which would make it bitter
Empty the noodles into a pre-heated bowl: mix in cheese and pepper
Top with onions which have been sauteed in butter , and garlic cloves
The aelplermagrone can be served at this point: often a green salad is served alongside
But if you prefer , you can also turn the mixture into a casserole and bake it in the oven long enough to brown the top nicely -- usually about twenty minutes at 400 f / 200 c
